panels.description: Minutes since last ingested row. LIVE <60min, STALE 60-360min, DOWN >360min.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time,
  greatest(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), now()), 0) AS lag_minutes
FROM ${summary_table}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
  AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Data freshness trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: AI Traffic Trend

panels.description: ASNs driving AI-labeled traffic, ranked by volume. Gradient gauge on share column.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_data AS (
    SELECT
      client_asn,
      cnt_all AS current_vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND notEmpty(ai_category)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      AND ('${lens}' = 'edge'
      OR ('${lens}' = 'seo' AND $__conditionalAll(resource_category IN (${policy_pages:sqlstring}), $policy_pages))
      OR ('${lens}' = 'security' AND is_bot_traffic = true))
    GROUP BY client_asn
  ),
  baseline_data AS (
    SELECT
      client_asn,
      cnt_all AS baseline_vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND notEmpty(ai_category)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      AND ('${lens}' = 'edge'
      OR ('${lens}' = 'seo' AND $__conditionalAll(resource_category IN (${policy_pages:sqlstring}), $policy_pages))
      OR ('${lens}' = 'security' AND is_bot_traffic = true))
    GROUP BY client_asn
  )
SELECT
  c.client_asn,
  c.current_vol AS vol,
  round(c.current_vol / greatest(sum(c.current_vol) OVER (), 1) * 100, 1) AS share_pct,
  if(b.baseline_vol > 0, round((c.current_vol - b.baseline_vol) / b.baseline_vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct
FROM current_data c
LEFT JOIN baseline_data b ON c.client_asn = b.client_asn
ORDER BY vol DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top AI sources (share + delta); du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Multi-dimension analysis: entities with the largest absolute volume delta. Security lens uses best-available bot categorization: Akamai SIEM bot_category when authoritative and thresholded, otherwise UA-derived bot_class; AI, ASN, and path dimensions keep their native semantics.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  ua_category_events AS (
    SELECT timestamp, bot_class AS class_key, cnt_all AS cnt
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE '${lens}' = 'security'
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      AND is_bot_traffic = true
    GROUP BY timestamp, bot_class
  ),
  siem_category_events AS (
    SELECT
      timestamp,
      akamai_canonical_bot_class AS class_key,
      bot_category AS siem_bot_category,
      bot_category_source AS siem_bot_category_source,
      bot_type AS siem_bot_type,
      cnt_all AS cnt
    FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
    WHERE '${lens}' = 'security'
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND notEmpty(bot_category)
      AND $__conditionalAll(akamai_canonical_bot_class IN (${bot_class_siem:singlequote}), $bot_class_siem)
    GROUP BY timestamp, class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
  ),
  current_traffic_total AS (
    SELECT coalesce(sum(cnt), 0) AS total
    FROM ua_category_events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  ),
  siem_evidence AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(sum(cnt), 0) AS siem_event_count,
      coalesce(sum(cnt) / nullIf((SELECT total FROM current_traffic_total), 0), 0) AS siem_coverage_pct
    FROM siem_category_events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  ),
  siem_threshold AS (
    SELECT
      siem_event_count,
      siem_coverage_pct,
      if(siem_event_count >= 20 OR siem_coverage_pct >= 0.05, 1, 0) AS meets_threshold
    FROM siem_evidence
  ),
  use_siem AS (
    SELECT if(
      '${classification_policy}' = 'akamai_authoritative'
      AND '${has_akamai_siem}' = '1'
      AND '${traffic_type}' IN ('all', 'bot')
      AND (SELECT meets_threshold FROM siem_threshold) = 1,
      1, 0
    ) AS flag
  )
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT
    entity,
    'Bot Category' AS dimension,
    'bot-insights-soc-what-changed' AS owner,
    current_vol,
    baseline_vol,
    current_vol - baseline_vol AS abs_delta,
    if(baseline_vol > 0, round((current_vol - baseline_vol) / baseline_vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct,
    canonical_bot_class,
    canonical_bot_class_source,
    canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    siem_bot_category,
    siem_bot_category_source,
    siem_event_count,
    siem_coverage_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT
      class_key AS entity,
      class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
      'ua_dict' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
      'derived' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
      '' AS siem_bot_category,
      '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
      (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
      (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
      sumIf(cnt, timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS current_vol,
      sumIf(cnt, timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS baseline_vol
    FROM ua_category_events
    WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 0
    GROUP BY entity, canonical_bot_class

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      siem_bot_category AS entity,
      class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
      'akamai_siem' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
      'authoritative' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
      (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
      sumIf(cnt, timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS current_vol,
      sumIf(cnt, timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS baseline_vol
    FROM siem_category_events
    WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 1
    GROUP BY entity, canonical_bot_class, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source
  )
  HAVING current_vol > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    entity,
    'ASN' AS dimension,
    'bot-insights-soc-what-changed' AS owner,
    sumIf(cnt, timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS current_vol,
    sumIf(cnt, timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS baseline_vol,
    current_vol - baseline_vol AS abs_delta,
    if(baseline_vol > 0, round((current_vol - baseline_vol) / baseline_vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    '' AS siem_bot_category,
    '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, client_asn AS entity, cnt_all AS cnt
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      AND ('${lens}' = 'edge'
      OR ('${lens}' = 'seo' AND $__conditionalAll(resource_category IN (${policy_pages:sqlstring}), $policy_pages))
      OR ('${lens}' = 'security' AND is_bot_traffic = true))
    GROUP BY timestamp, client_asn
  )
  GROUP BY entity
  HAVING current_vol > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    entity,
    'AI Category' AS dimension,
    'bot-insights-seo-governance' AS owner,
    sumIf(cnt, timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS current_vol,
    sumIf(cnt, timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS baseline_vol,
    current_vol - baseline_vol AS abs_delta,
    if(baseline_vol > 0, round((current_vol - baseline_vol) / baseline_vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    '' AS siem_bot_category,
    '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT timestamp, ai_category AS entity, cnt_all AS cnt
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      AND notEmpty(ai_category)
      AND ('${lens}' = 'edge'
      OR ('${lens}' = 'seo' AND $__conditionalAll(resource_category IN (${policy_pages:sqlstring}), $policy_pages))
      OR ('${lens}' = 'security' AND is_bot_traffic = true))
    GROUP BY timestamp, ai_category
  )
  GROUP BY entity
  HAVING current_vol > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    entity,
    'Path' AS dimension,
    'bot-insights-edge-ops' AS owner,
    sumIf(cnt, timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS current_vol,
    sumIf(cnt, timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS baseline_vol,
    current_vol - baseline_vol AS abs_delta,
    if(baseline_vol > 0, round((current_vol - baseline_vol) / baseline_vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    '' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    '' AS siem_bot_category,
    '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT reqTimeSec AS timestamp, request_path_norm AS entity, count() AS cnt
    FROM ${raw_table}
    WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
      AND reqTimeSec <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__adHocFilter()
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      AND notEmpty(request_path_norm)
      AND ('${lens}' = 'edge' OR (reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})))
    GROUP BY timestamp, request_path_norm
  )
  GROUP BY entity
  HAVING current_vol > 0
)
ORDER BY multiIf(
  '${lens}' = 'seo', multiIf(dimension = 'AI Category', 0, dimension = 'Path', 1, 2),
  '${lens}' = 'security', multiIf(dimension = 'Bot Category', 0, dimension = 'ASN', 1, 2),
  multiIf(dimension = 'Path', 0, dimension = 'ASN', 1, 2)
) ASC, abs(abs_delta) DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top movers (canonical category); du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Enriches the Top Movers analysis with SIEM signals: threat intel matches, failed logins correlated with bot ASNs, transaction anomalies. Requires SIEM data.

targets.rawSql:
-- SIEM Enrichment Top Movers — siem_signals CTE routed to raw SIEM so global filters stay honest
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  top_movers AS (
    SELECT
      entity,
      'ASN' AS dimension,
      sumIf(cnt, timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS current_vol,
      sumIf(cnt, timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})) AS baseline_vol,
      current_vol - baseline_vol AS abs_delta,
      if(baseline_vol > 0, round((current_vol - baseline_vol) / baseline_vol * 100, 1), 999) AS delta_pct
    FROM (
      SELECT timestamp, client_asn AS entity, cnt_all AS cnt
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} HOUR
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND '${siem_available}' = '1'
        AND $__adHocFilter()
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
        AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
        AND ('${lens}' = 'edge'
      OR ('${lens}' = 'seo' AND $__conditionalAll(resource_category IN (${policy_pages:sqlstring}), $policy_pages))
      OR ('${lens}' = 'security' AND is_bot_traffic = true))
      GROUP BY timestamp, client_asn
    )
    GROUP BY entity
    HAVING current_vol > 0
    ORDER BY abs(abs_delta) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ),
  siem_signals AS (
    SELECT
      client_asn,
      countIf(or(equals(action_taken, 'deny'), equals(action_taken, 'block'))) AS blocked_count,
      countIf(equals(auth_outcome, 'fail')) AS failed_logins,
      round(avg(bot_score), 1) AS avg_score
    FROM ${siem_raw_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${site:sqlstring}), $site)
      AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all' OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND is_bot_traffic = true) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND is_bot_traffic = false) OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND notEmpty(ai_category)))
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND ('${lens}' = 'edge'
      OR ('${lens}' = 'seo' AND $__conditionalAll(resource_category IN (${policy_pages:sqlstring}), $policy_pages))
      OR ('${lens}' = 'security' AND is_bot_traffic = true))
      AND client_asn IN (SELECT entity FROM top_movers)
    GROUP BY client_asn
  )
SELECT
  m.entity,
  m.dimension,
  m.current_vol,
  m.baseline_vol,
  m.abs_delta,
  m.delta_pct,
  s.blocked_count,
  s.failed_logins,
  s.avg_score AS avg_bot_score
FROM top_movers m
LEFT JOIN siem_signals s ON m.entity = s.client_asn
ORDER BY abs(abs_delta) DESC
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=SIEM enrichment top movers (raw siem); du=${__user.login}'
